gloss: to assemble; to build up; to construct

definitions.gloss: to assemble, to build up, to put together
definitions.explanation: To combine parts or elements into a complete structure or system.

examples.japanese: {部品|ぶひん}を{組|く}み{上|あ}げる。
プラモデルを{一|いち}から{組|く}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: I built a plastic model from scratch.

examples.japanese: チーム{全員|ぜんいん}で{議論|ぎろん}を{重|かさ}ねて、{新|あたら}しい{計画|けいかく}を{組|く}み{上|あ}げた。
examples.english: The entire team had repeated discussions and put together a new plan.

notes:
Compound of {組|く}む (to put together) + {上|あ}げる (to complete, to finish). The {上|あ}げる component adds a sense of completion.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {部品|ぶひん}を{組|く}み{上|あ}げる: to assemble parts
- システムを{組|く}み{上|あ}げる: to build a system
- {計画|けいかく}を{組|く}み{上|あ}げる: to put together a plan
- {一|いち}から{組|く}み{上|あ}げる: to build from scratch

COMPARISON:
- {組|く}み{立|た}てる: to assemble (more mechanical/factory-like)
- {組|く}み{上|あ}げる: to build up (emphasizes completion, more creative)

CONJUGATION:
- {組|く}み{上|あ}げない（{否定|ひてい}）
- {組|く}み{上|あ}げます（{丁寧|ていねい}）
- {組|く}み{上|あ}げて（て{形|けい}）
- {組|く}み{上|あ}げた（{過去|かこ}）
